### A love letter to Scotland

Aneo-Gothic palace dedicated to exploring various aspects of the Scottish story, this gallery is a hidden gem right at the heart of Edinburgh. The art tells you stories of the land and its people, through the medium of imagery.

Meet with friends in the welcoming Café Portrait. Find other familiar faces when you discover contemporary portraits of pop culture icons like Billy Connolly, Emeli Sandé and Tilda Swinton in the galleries above. You will spot recent pioneers in science, sport and the arts and sit alongside famous historical figures such as Mary Queen of Scots, Robert Burns and Charles Edward Stuart.

The gallery is decorated in elaborate murals and sculptural embellishments inside and out - really, take time to look up at the Zodiac ceiling in the world-famous Great Hall. Seriously, it is like 2,000 golden stars and 47 constellations! Bedazzling.

[See all exhibitions and displays at the Portrait](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/whats-on?what%5Bexhibition%5D=exhibition&what%5Broom%5D=room&where%5Bportrait%5D=portrait&when=on_now)

## Community & access groups

We invite community and access groups to explore Scotland’s national collection for free through guided or self-led visits and free entry to all ticketed exhibitions. We also offer a range of [regularly scheduled events for visitors with specific access needs](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/whats-on?what%5Ball_events%5D=all_events&what%5B46326%5D=46326&what%5B46311%5D=46311&what%5B46316%5D=46316&what%5B46321%5D=46321&what%5B46331%5D=46331&what%5B46336%5D=46336&what%5B46341%5D=46341&when=on_now&audience=46286&date-range-from=&date-range-to=) aiming to create a relaxed, welcoming and sociable environment where all contributions are welcomed and valued

[Book a group visit](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/visit/groups-tours-workshops/community-access-groups)

[See more BSL resources](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/learn/british-sign-language)

### Audio described introduction to the Portrait

This audio described introduction to the Portrait features descriptions of the building and its layout, information about artworks on display and the facilities available.

### Portrait: visual introduction

Watch this short video and plan your visit to the Portrait. The video introduces the buildings, the facilities, and the collection. It will also help you find the areas best suited to you.

We offer sensory-friendly events and resources created for and with autistic visitors, visitors with learning disabilities and those with additional sensory needs in mind.

[Sensory-friendly resources](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/learn/sensory-friendly)

## Audio and visitor guides

Explore your national collection and get more from our exhibitons with our free digital guides.

### Audio tour

This audio tour will guide you through the Portrait. You’ll hear from a variety of artists, authors, academics, curators and commentators. 

[Listen now Audio tour](https://links.bloombergconnects.org/6Ggw/92pwlfsx)

### Audio described tour

Enjoy an audio described tour of iconic portraits at the Portrait. 

[Listen now Audio described tour](https://links.bloombergconnects.org/6Ggw/7yzjodzb)

### British sign language tour

Enjoy this British Sign Language (BSL) tour of artworks from at the Portrait gallery. You can follow the tour in the gallery using your own smartphone or watch at home.

[Watch now British sign language tour](https://links.bloombergconnects.org/6Ggw/w793bfnk)

### Tour of The Great Hall at the Scottish National Portrait Gallery

Liz Louis, Curator of Portraiture introduces the [Great Hall](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/art-and-artists/features/great-hall-portrait-gallery) of the Scottish National Portrait Gallery. Liz gives us a tour of the elaborate decorative interior and examines the glittering frieze and mural decorations by [William Brassey Hole](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/art-and-artists/artists/william-brassey-hole). The Great Hall is a work of art in itself, and Liz explains how the decorative scheme relates to both the outside of the building, and the contents that it was purpose built to house.

[See more video tours](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/visit/tours-national-galleries-scotland)

[Book now](https://www.heritageportfolio.co.uk/cafes/cafe-portrait)

**Open daily, 10am-5pm**

+44 (0)131 624 6494

Visit our gallery shop for an inspiring range of Scottish gifts, books, limited edition prints, stationery, fashion, jewellery, food and drink, homeware and exclusive products featuring well-loved images from Scottish artworks.

[Shop online](https://shop.nationalgalleries.org)

## Library and Print Room at the Portrait

The Library provides access to resources relating to portraiture and Scottish history. The Print Room houses over 50,000 works of art on paper, including the Photography Collection, and a notable collection of portrait miniatures.

All visitors are welcome to use the Library and Print Room at the Portrait, whether for pleasure or for academic study.

Visits are free but must be pre-booked.

[Find out more](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/visit/research-facilities/library-print-room-portrait)

# Sudley House

Explore the house of George Holt and his family, a Victorian merchant with impeccable taste in period furniture and paintings.

Open Tuesday to Sunday

10am-4pm

Closes in 4 hours 55 mins

[Mossley Hill Road, Liverpool, L18 8BX](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=Mossley Hill Road,Liverpool,United Kingdom,L18 8BX)

Pause video

- [Explore Sudley House](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house#section--explore-sudley-house)
- [What's on](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house#section--whats-on)
- [Plan your visit](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house#section--plan-your-visit)

## Explore Sudley House

[**Dining room**\\ \\ The Holts used this room to entertain their wealthy friends. Original features include the sideboard with George Holt’s initials and the wallpaper, which has never been repainted. The portraits within the dining room are by some of the finest painters from the 18th and early 19th century, including Thomas Gainsborough and Sir Joshua Reynolds](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house/sudley-house-room-guide-and-collection/dining-room)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house/sudley-house-room-guide-and-collection/dining-room)

[**Innocence and Beauty: Children and Animals in Art (1700-1900)**\\ \\ Permanent display\\ \\ Innocence and Beauty explores how artists between 1700 and 1900 reimagined childhood and its connection with the natural world.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/whatson/sudley-house/exhibition/innocence-and-beauty-children-and-animals-art-1700-1900)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/whatson/sudley-house/exhibition/innocence-and-beauty-children-and-animals-art-1700-1900)

[**Drawing room**\\ \\ This was the Holts' best sitting room. The fireplace and paintings still remain in their original position, but everything else has changed. Although the Holts's furniture has gone, we have furnished the corner of the room with original victorian furniture to recreate a similar look.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house/sudley-house-room-guide-and-collection/drawing-room)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house/sudley-house-room-guide-and-collection/drawing-room)

[**Library**\\ \\ George Holt put in the fitted bookcases, chimneypiece and embossed wallpaper in this room. He probably used it as his study.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house/sudley-house-room-guide-and-collection/library)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house/sudley-house-room-guide-and-collection/library)

[**Morning room**\\ \\ Emma Holt used this as her office after her father died in 1896. From here she helped to run Liverpool University, an area of the District Nursing Association, and many other health charities.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house/sudley-house-room-guide-and-collection/morning-room)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house/sudley-house-room-guide-and-collection/morning-room)

[**Entrance hall**\\ \\ In the entrance hall you will find paintings by artists such as John Everett Millais, Edward Burne-Jones, Sir Lawrence Alma-Tadema and Henriette Browne.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house/sudley-house-room-guide-and-collection/entrance-hall)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house/sudley-house-room-guide-and-collection/entrance-hall)

[View room guide and collections](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house/sudley-house-room-guide-and-collection)

### Café

Pop into our charming tea room on the ground floor for a hot drink and some cake. We also have a courtyard seating area for the warmer months, which can be found at the rear of the property.

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/cafe-hub)

## What's on

[**Group tour of Sudley House**\\ \\ Adult groups can book a tour to discover the fascinating history of Sudley House, the Holt Family, and the fine collection of artworks on display.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/group-tour-of-sudley-house)

[**Meet and make: dry point printing at Sudley House**\\ \\ 12 Feb 2027Friday, 12th February, 2027—to13 Feb 2027Saturday, 13th February, 2027\\ \\ Learn the basics of dry point etching, a printing technique from the intaglio family where images are scored onto a hard surface which is then used to…\\ \\ Sudley House](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/whatson/sudley-house/event/meet-and-make-dry-point-printing-sudley-house)

[**The Art of Observation | Life drawing at Sudley**\\ \\ 11 Jul 2026Saturday, 11th July, 2026—to13 Feb 2027Saturday, 13th February, 2027\\ \\ Be inspired by the world-class artworks on display in Sudley House and hone your own skills depicting the human form in our life drawing sessions\\ \\ Sudley House](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/whatson/sudley-house/event/art-of-observation-life-drawing-sudley)

[**Meet and make: paper making at Sudley House**\\ \\ 10 Apr 2026Friday, 10th April, 2026—to10 Apr 2026Friday, 10th April, 2026\\ \\ Make beautiful sheets of unique paper using a technique that’s perfect for beginners and experienced makers alike\\ \\ Sudley House](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/whatson/sudley-house/event/meet-and-make-paper-making-sudley-house)

[View all events and exhibitions at Sudley House](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/whatson?&venue[]=Sudley%20House)

## Plan your visit

Getting Here

Sudley House

Mossley Hill Road, Liverpool, United Kingdom L18 8BX

- car
- train
- bus

Sudley House is approximately a 20 minute drive from Liverpool city centre. Follow 'Wapping' (A5036) out of the city. Free parking is available at Sudley House, but parking is limited.

[Get Directions](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=Mossley Hill Road,Liverpool,United Kingdom,L18 8BX)

Open Tuesday to Sunday

 10am-4pm

Closes in 4 hours 55 mins

### Audio Guide

Explore the impressive interior design, furnishings and artwork that make this victorian merchant home so special.

[Listen here](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house-audio-guide)

### Opening hours

From 2 November we change to our winter opening hours, 10am-4pm Tuesday to Sunday.

We are closed on Mondays except during the school holidays. 

Our opening hours will change over the Christmas holidays, check our [Christmas page](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/christmas#section--visiting-us-this-festive-season) for more details.

Please check our [visit page](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/visit) and social media for the latest information.

### Free entry

Admission to National Museums Liverpool's museums and galleries is free. Donations are welcome.

Special exhibitions and events may have an additional charge. Exhibitions are free for National Museums Liverpool Members.

[Schools and large groups need to book.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/learn/schools-home/plan-your-trip)

[Donate](https://book.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/events/3d5b25e1-5e77-532b-a01c-c2a405c2712d)

[**Room guide**\\ \\ The ground floor has paintings by Turner, Rossetti, Holman Hunt and many other great artists. The first floor contains our childhood room, costume room, small world room and special exhibitions.](entity:node/80427)

[View room guide](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house/sudley-house-room-guide-and-collection)

[**Access and facilities**\\ \\ All you need to know before visiting Sudley House.](entity:node/45900)

[**Schools and groups**\\ \\ Sudley House is a great place to learn about the Victorians, as well as exploring childhood through toys old and new.](entity:node/49443) 

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/learn/schools-home/plan-your-trip/sudley-house-schools-and-groups-info)

### The original features of Sudley House

From stained glass windows to embossed flock wallpaper, explore the distinct style of Sudley. 

[Read](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/stories/original-features-of-sudley-house)

## About

[**Holt the collector**\\ \\ George Holt began collecting seriously in middle age, around the late1860s. Holt did not collect art simply as a status symbol, as some merchant collectors may have done. He paid a great deal of attention to the presentation of his works, from framing to glazing, and his early buying concentrated on English landscapes and genre pieces, prints and Chinese porcelain](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house/holt-collector)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house/holt-collector)

[**The history of Sudley House**\\ \\ The history of Sudley House begins in the first decade of the 19th century. Today Sudley House is one of the few period homes decorated in a Victorian style that still has many of its original features. It is also the only surviving Victorian merchant art collection in Britain still hanging in its original location.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house/history-of-sudley-house)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sudley-house/history-of-sudley-house)

[**The Holt family**\\ \\ George Holt came from a family of prominent local businessmen. George Holt married Elizabeth Bright. Their only child Emma was born in 1862. The family lived in Edge Lane and then West Derby before settling at Sudley in 1884.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/holt-family)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/holt-family)

# Lady Lever Art Gallery

A beautiful building housing one of the UK's finest collections of fine and decorative art.

Open Tuesday to Sunday

10am-4pm

Closes in 4 hours 55 mins

[Port Sunlight Village, Wirral, CH62 5EQ](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=Port Sunlight Village,Wirral,United Kingdom,CH62 5EQ )

Pause video

- [What's on](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/lady-lever-art-gallery#section--whats-on)
- [Collections](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/lady-lever-art-gallery#section--collections)
- [Plan your visit](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/lady-lever-art-gallery#section--plan-your-visit)
- [About](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/lady-lever-art-gallery#section--about)

- [Shop](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/lady-lever-art-gallery#section--shop)

## What's on

[**Conservation on View**\\ \\ Various dates\\ \\ See the story behind the conservation of four Spanish altarpiece panels, dating from the early 1400s.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/whatson/lady-lever-art-gallery/exhibition/conservation-view)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/whatson/lady-lever-art-gallery/exhibition/conservation-view)

[**Main Hall**\\ \\ Discover a wealth of incredible Victorian art including the Pre-Raphaelites, Leighton, Sargent, Waterhouse, Alma Tadema and more.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/lady-lever-art-gallery/room-guide/main-hall)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/lady-lever-art-gallery/room-guide/main-hall)

[**Chinese ceramics**\\ \\ Rooms 7 and 8\\ \\ Discover William Lever's collection of Chinese pottery and porcelain - including special low level displays for younger visitors!](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/lady-lever-art-gallery/room-guide/rooms-7-and-8)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/lady-lever-art-gallery/room-guide/rooms-7-and-8)

[View all events and exhibitions at Lady Lever Art Gallery](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/whatson?&venue[]=Lady%20Lever%20Art%20Gallery)

### Café

Tuck into a lovely lunch on the lower ground floor of our historic gallery. 

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/cafe-hub)

## Collections

[**Paintings at Lady Lever**\\ \\ The Lady Lever Art Gallery holds a unique group of key paintings by some of the greatest Victorian painters including the Pre-Raphaelites and Leighton\\ \\ Lady Lever Art Gallery](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/collections/lady-lever-art-gallery-collections/paintings-lady-lever)

[**Wedgwood collection**\\ \\ **Rooms 3 and 4**\\ \\ The Lady Lever Art Gallery houses one of the most significant collections of Wedgwood jasperware in the UK.\\ \\ Lady Lever Art Gallery](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/collections/lady-lever-art-gallery-collections/wedgwood-collection)

[**Classical antiquities collection**\\ \\ Explore the antiquities collection at Lady Lever Art Gallery including ancient Greek and Roman vases and sculptures, including the elegant sculpture of Antinous. \\ \\ Lady Lever Art Gallery](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/collections/lady-lever-art-gallery-collections/classical-antiquities-collection)

[**Star objects from the South End galleries**\\ \\ These fantastic objects give a flavour of the displays in the South End galleries. They include favourites such as the sculpture of Salammbo by Maurice Ferrary, Chinese ceramics, Wedgwood and 18th century paintings.\\ \\ Lady Lever Art Gallery](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/collections/lady-lever-art-gallery-collections/star-objects-south-end-galleries)

[See more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/collections/lady-lever-art-gallery-collections)

## Plan your visit

Getting Here

Lady Lever Art Gallery

Port Sunlight Village, Wirral, United Kingdom CH62 5EQ

- car
- train
- bus
- walking

If you are travelling from Liverpool, use the Birkenhead (Queensway) tunnel. From elsewhere, leave the M53 at junction 4 and follow the signs for Port Sunlight village. There is free parking for more than 100 cars outside the gallery.

[Get Directions](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=Port Sunlight Village,Wirral,United Kingdom,CH62 5EQ )

Open Tuesday to Sunday

 10am-4pm

Closes in 4 hours 55 mins

### Opening hours

From 2 November we change to our winter opening hours, 10am-4pm Tuesday to Sunday.

We are closed on Mondays except during the school holidays. 

Our opening hours will change over the Christmas holidays, check our [Christmas page](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/christmas#section--visiting-us-this-festive-season) for more details.

Please check our [visit page](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/visit) and social media for the latest information.

### Free entry

Admission to National Museums Liverpool's museums and galleries is free. Donations are welcome.

Special exhibitions and events may have an additional charge. Exhibitions are free for National Museums Liverpool Members.

[Schools and large groups need to book.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/learn/schools-home/plan-your-trip)

[View room guide](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/lady-lever-art-gallery/room-guide)

[**Access and facilities**\\ \\ Planning a visit? Find out all you need to know before exploring our collections.](entity:node/45899)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/learn/schools-home/plan-your-trip/lady-lever-art-gallery-schools-and-groups-info)

## About

[**The story of Lever**\\ \\ William Hesketh Lever was a multimillionaire businessman, entrepreneur and philanthropist. Find out how Lever made a large contribution to the lives of ordinary people and his passion for art.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/lady-lever-art-gallery/story-of-lever)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/lady-lever-art-gallery/story-of-lever)

[**Our history**\\ \\ Founded by William Hesketh Lever, the Lady Lever Art Gallery houses one of the UK’s finest collections of fine and decorative art. Find out about the diverse artworks on display, including the gallery's world famous Pre-Raphaelite paintings.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/lady-lever-art-gallery/about-lady-lever-art-gallery)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/lady-lever-art-gallery/about-lady-lever-art-gallery)

[**Top 12 facts**\\ \\ Did you know Lever was fascinated by the French Emperor Napoleon and collected furniture, decorative arts and memorabilia associated with him, or that the gallery has one of the most significant collections of Wedgwood jasperware in the UK?](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/lady-lever-art-gallery/top-12-facts)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/lady-lever-art-gallery/top-12-facts)

### Become a member

With National Museums Liverpool Membership you get a whole year of incredible experiences and new discoveries, plus exclusive members-only benefits. 

Go First. Go Free. Discover More.

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/join-and-support/membership)

[Read more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/stories)

# Walker Art Gallery

Beautiful paintings, sculpture and decorative art from the 13th century to the present day.

Open Tuesday to Sunday

10am-4pm

Closes in 4 hours 55 mins

[William Brown St , Liverpool, L3 8EL](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=William Brown St ,Liverpool,United Kingdom,L3 8EL)

Pause video

- [What's on](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/walker-art-gallery#section--whats-on)
- [Collections](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/walker-art-gallery#section--collections)
- [Getting here](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/walker-art-gallery#section--getting-here)
- [Explore online](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/walker-art-gallery#section--explore-online)

## What's on

[**Mary Magdalene: Woman and Myth**\\ \\ 6 Feb 2027—23 May 2027\\ \\ Discover the saint, sinner, witness and icon who has fascinated artists and audiences for centuries.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/whatson/walker-art-gallery/exhibition/mary-magdalene-woman-and-myth)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/whatson/walker-art-gallery/exhibition/mary-magdalene-woman-and-myth)

[**Ally Fallon: The Shape of a Room**\\ \\ 14 Nov 2026—16 May 2027\\ \\ A solo exhibition of new paintings by the youngest artist ever to win the John Moores Painting Prize.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/whatson/walker-art-gallery/exhibition/ally-fallon-shape-of-room)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/whatson/walker-art-gallery/exhibition/ally-fallon-shape-of-room)

[**Made from Scratch: Celebrating Ceramicist Julia Carter Preston**\\ \\ 11 Sep 2026—28 Feb 2027\\ \\ A display of seven stunning pieces by Julia Carter Preston, commemorating the centenary of her birth in 1926.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/whatson/walker-art-gallery/exhibition/made-scratch-celebrating-ceramicist-julia-carter-preston)

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/whatson/walker-art-gallery/exhibition/made-scratch-celebrating-ceramicist-julia-carter-preston)

[View all events and exhibitions at Walker Art Gallery](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/whatson?&venue[]=Walker%20Art%20Gallery)

## Collections

[**Paintings**\\ \\ The Walker Art Gallery has one of the most important and renowned painting collections in the UK. The collection includes European Renaissance paintings, masterpieces by Rubens, Rembrandt, Turner and Stubbs, Pre-Raphaelite artworks by Rossetti and Millais, Impressionist works by Monet and Degas a…\\ \\ Walker Art Gallery](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/collections/walker-art-gallery/paintings)

[**Sculpture**\\ \\ The Walker Art Gallery's sculpture collection is particularly known for its outstanding collection of works made between the 18th century and the First World War, from the high period of neo-classicism to the era of 'New Sculpture' in Britain.\\ \\ Walker Art Gallery](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/sculpture)

[**Decorative art**\\ \\ The Walker has a great collection of British and European decorative art, dating from 1300 to the present day. \\ \\ Walker Art Gallery](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/decorative-art)

[View all](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/collections/walker-art-gallery-collections)

### Café

Enjoy a bite to eat in our café – based on the ground floor in the heart of the gallery – surrounded by sculptures and paintings.

[Find out more](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/cafe-hub)

## Getting here

Getting Here

Walker Art Gallery

William Brown St , Liverpool, United Kingdom L3 8EL

- car
- train
- bus

The Walker is close to the entrance to the Queensway Tunnel. There is pay and display parking outside the gallery on William Brown Street and behind World Museum on Hunter Street. The nearest other car park is at Queen Square.

[Get Directions](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=William Brown St ,Liverpool,United Kingdom,L3 8EL)

Open Tuesday to Sunday

Closes in 4 hours 55 mins

### Opening hours

From 2 November we change to our winter opening hours, 10am-4pm Tuesday to Sunday.

We are closed on Mondays except during the school holidays. 

Our opening hours will change over the Christmas holidays, check our [Christmas page](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/christmas#section--visiting-us-this-festive-season) for more details.

Please check our [visit page](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/visit) and social media for the latest information.

Admission to National Museums Liverpool's museums and galleries is free. Donations are welcome.

[**Access and facilities**\\ \\ Planning a visit? Find out all you need to know before exploring the collection.](entity:node/45898)

## Explore online

[**Highlights audio tour**\\ \\ Our free audio guides connect you to a world of insight and expertise, bringing our world-leading collections to life. Our fascinating Walker highlights guide explores some of the most renowned artworks in our collection, including 'Dante's Dream' by Dante Gabriel Rossetti and 'Peter Getting Out of Nick's Pool' by David Hockney.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/walker-art-gallery-audio-guide)

[Listen now](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/walker-art-gallery-audio-guide)

[**Black History Month**\\ \\ Year-round, you can explore stories, interviews, collections and features on Liverpool's Black community, from our collections across NML and the city.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/black-history-month)

[**Inspirational women**\\ \\ Meet some of the incredible pioneering women featured in National Museums Liverpool's collections and displays](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/inspirational-women#section--women-in-the-arts)

## About

[**County Sessions House**\\ \\ County\\ \\ The County Sessions House was built between 1882 and 1884 to house the Quarter Sessions for the West Derby Hundred of the county of Lancaster.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/walker-art-gallery/county-sessions-house)

[**History of the gallery**\\ \\ The Walker Art Gallery is the national gallery of the North. Since 1877, it has housed Liverpool’s most outstanding art collection. Many of the gallery’s most important works have been on display in the city for nearly 200 years.](https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/walker-art-gallery/history-of-walker)

See over 50 of his paintings that uncover a different side to one of the defining figures of the 20th century

23 May–29 November 2026

## Welcome to The McManus:   
Dundee's Art Gallery and Museum

Step into The McManus: Dundee’s Art Gallery & Museum and discover the story of our city. With **free admission**, **open 7 days** and **a warm welcome**, you’ll find a rich blend of art, culture, history and the natural world - all within the stunning architecture of our Gothic Revival building.

[Read more](https://www.mcmanus.co.uk/visit)

---

## The McManus Café

Sandwiches, soup, cakes and coffee in the heart of Dundee.

[Learn more](https://www.mcmanus.co.uk/cafe)

## The Galleries

Wander through **8 captivating galleries** across two floors and journey through **400 million years** of history. Discover how Dundee evolved from a small settlement into the coolest little city it is today.

[Read More »](https://www.mcmanus.co.uk/galleries)

## What's On

There’s always something happening at The McManus and our other locations! Expect new exhibitions with historic and modern art, **free talks and tours** and **fun family activities** - our calendar is packed with events to inspire and entertain. Plan your visit today.

[Read More »](https://www.mcmanus.co.uk/exhibitions)

## Collections

Explore Dundee’s story through a remarkable collection of art and artefacts. From local treasures to objects and paintings that are recognised as of **national and international significance** - our displays celebrate the story of the city and its role in the rich history of Scottish art. 

[Read More »](https://www.mcmanus.co.uk/collections)

## Creative Learning

Explore Dundee’s story through a remarkable collection of art and artefacts. From local treasures to objects and paintings that are recognised as of **national and international significance** - our displays celebrate the story of the city and its role in the rich history of Scottish art. 

[Read More »](https://www.mcmanus.co.uk/creative-learning)

---

**Visited recently?**

Help us understand who visits us and why.

[Take our quick Survey](https://www.mcmanus.co.uk/visitor-survey)

## Object of the Month

### Caledon Shipbuilding Medal

Jeannie, a volunteer at the McManus Collections Unit, talks about a medal donated by a Caledon shipyard worker, as well as the history of the Caledon company. 

The medal is on display in The McManus's This Just In exhibition, open until 20 October 2024, free entry.

# What’s On

Find an event or exhibition near you.

[What's New](https://www.culturepk.org.uk/what-is-on/)

## Lessons of the Hour

Turner Prize-nominated British artist Isaac Julien CBE RA brings his acclaimed film-based installation Lessons of the Hour – Frederick Douglass (2019) to Perth Museum. Presented as part of the ARTIST ROOMS programme, Perth is the first venue on the tour and the only place to experience the work in Scotland. Now open.

[Find Out More](https://www.culturepk.org.uk/event/lessons-of-the-hour/)

## Lys Hansen: A Retrospective

Celebrate the 90th birthday year of one of Scotland’s most significant living artists in this major retrospective exhibition at Perth Art Gallery. Opening 27 November 2026.

[Book Now](https://culturepk.digitickets.co.uk/event-tickets/82396?branches.branchID=4095)

## Explore your Library

Discover your local library today, renew your books, find out what’s on and more.

[Find Out More](https://www.culturepk.org.uk/libraries/)

## Local & Family History

Everyone has a history – do we have a piece of yours? Explore the rich and fascinating history of Perth & Kinross through our historic records and printed collections.

[Find Out More](https://www.culturepk.org.uk/archivelfh/)

## Venue Hire

Planning your own event? We have a huge range of spaces to suit events suitable for everything from community and charity outreach to business catering.

[Venue Hire](https://www.culturepk.org.uk/about/venue-hire/)

## Support Us

Did you know we’re an independent registered charity? There are lots of ways you can support us – whether that’s making a donation, volunteering or joining our supporters scheme.

[Support Us](https://culturepk.enthuse.com/)

### Libraries

Whether you want to renew your library book online or find your local library, our range of services are there to help you.

# Welcome to The Burrell Collection

Explore 6,000 years of art and history. Entry is FREE!

[Plan your visit now](https://burrellcollection.com/visit/)

### Drawing Inspiration

1 September - 26 November 2026

Drawing Inspiration brings together thirteen remarkable drawings, featuring works by internationally renowned artists including Jean Auguste Dominique Ingres, Édouard Manet and Jean-François Millet.

[Find out more](https://burrellcollection.com/drawing-inspiration/)

### Home to world-class international and Scottish art from 1300 to 1945

Open, free to all. Yours to discover.

Immerse yourself in this breath-taking art collection. Experience paintings by internationally renowned artists such as Vermeer, Titian, Rembrandt, Velázquez and the Impressionists. Explore the Scottish galleries where you can encounter the very best of Scottish art from 1800 to 1945. Marvel at spectacular views over Edinburgh and discover the work of pioneering artists such as William McTaggart, Anne Redpath, Phoebe Anna Traquair and the Glasgow Boys.

Enjoy food and drink at the gallery café and restaurant and browse our exciting range of art-inspired gifts and books in the gallery shop.

Whether you are new to the gallery, doing research or just passing by, the National welcomes everyone to explore art, make discoveries or just simply take time to unwind.

[See all exhibitions and displays at the National](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/whats-on?what%5Bexhibition%5D=exhibition&what%5Broom%5D=room&where%5Bnational%5D=national&when=on_now)

## Accessibility & facilities

[Detailed information on accessibility at the National Galleries of Scotland](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/visit/accessibility)

Our partial Changing Places toilet has all of the facilities of a full Changing Places toilet, and though the floor area meets the overall size requirement (13.54m2 minimum), it is just a little too narrow to be classed as a full Changing Places toilet.

There are a limited number of small lockers available, but there is no space to store large items of luggage.

Two accessible car parking spaces are available on site and should be [booked in advance](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/visit/parking-national-blue-badge). There is also on street [parking](https://www.edinburgh.gov.uk/parking-spaces/find-parking-bays) close by including for those with a blue badge.

[\\ \\ Drop-in event | Families & children\\ \\ **Family Fridays**\\ \\ **National**\\ \\ Every Fri during term time 10am–4pm Free Drop-in. No booking required.\\ \\ More Info](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/event/family-fridays)

[See all events](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/whats-on?what%5Ball_events%5D=all_events&what%5B46326%5D=46326&what%5B46311%5D=46311&what%5B46316%5D=46316&what%5B136589%5D=136589&what%5B46321%5D=46321&what%5B46331%5D=46331&what%5B46336%5D=46336&what%5B46341%5D=46341&where%5Bnational%5D=national)

## Families

Make a day of it, explore the galleries and pack a picnic or sample the [children's menu](https://www.contini.com/scottish-cafe-and-restaurant/menus/childrens-menu/) at The Scottish Cafe & Restaurant.

[Visit our Families page](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/visit/families)

[See all family events at the National](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/whats-on?where%5Bnational%5D=national&when=on_now&audience=46296)

### Free Family Trails

Explore the Scottish galleries, together, with our Art Stomps (under 5s) and Art Chat (ages 6+) trails. 

[Download Art Stomps (under 5s) Free Family Trails](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/sites/default/files/art-stomps-national-download.pdf)

[Download Art Chat (ages 5+) Free Family Trails](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/sites/default/files/art-chats-download.pdf)

### Family Fridays

Fridays are for families! Every Friday during term-time we have new play activities, sensory spaces and, of course, hands-on making with artists.

[Find out more Family Fridays](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/event/family-fridays)

### Art Trolley

Pick up and play! You’ll find drawing materials, story books, cosy cushions, ear defenders, sketchbooks, paper and Sensory Bags – to help you make the most of a visit to the galleries!

## Community & access

We invite community and access groups to explore Scotland’s national collection for free through guided or self-led visits and free entry to all ticketed exhibitions. We also offer a range of [regularly scheduled events for visitors with specific access needs](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/whats-on?what%5Ball_events%5D=all_events&what%5B46326%5D=46326&what%5B46311%5D=46311&what%5B46316%5D=46316&what%5B46321%5D=46321&what%5B46331%5D=46331&what%5B46336%5D=46336&what%5B46341%5D=46341&when=on_now&audience=46286&date-range-from=&date-range-to=) aiming to create a relaxed, welcoming and sociable environment where all contributions are welcomed and valued.

[Book a group visit](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/visit/groups-tours-workshops/community-access-groups)

[Explore our events](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/whats-on?what%5Ball_events%5D=all_events&what%5B46326%5D=46326&what%5B46311%5D=46311&what%5B46316%5D=46316&what%5B46321%5D=46321&what%5B46331%5D=46331&what%5B46336%5D=46336&what%5B46341%5D=46341&when=on_now&audience=46286)

[Audio described tour (National)](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/art-and-artists/features/visually-impaired-tour-scottish-national-gallery-highlights)

[BSL tour (Bloomberg Connects)](https://links.bloombergconnects.org/6Ggw/g9molyzw)

### BSL introduction

Presented by Trudi Collier, this short welcome film in British Sign Language (BSL) introduces the building and collections of the National.

[See more BSL resources](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/learn/british-sign-language)

### Audio described introduction

This audio described introduction to the National features descriptions of the building and its layout, information about artworks on display and the facilities available.

### National: visual introduction

Watch this short video and plan your visit to the National. The video introduces the buildings, the facilities, and the collection. It will also help you find the areas best suited to you.

We offer sensory-friendly events and resources created for and with autistic visitors, visitors with learning disabilities and those with additional sensory needs in mind.

[Sensory-friendly resources](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/learn/sensory-friendly)

## Audio and visitor guides

Explore your national collection and get more from our exhibitons with our free digital guides.

### Digital guides

Explore the National through different themed guides that include our best loved artworks, and discover incredible Scottish and International artists along the way.

[Listen now Digital guides](https://links.bloombergconnects.org/6Ggw/ad9urtuh)

### Audio described tour

Audio descriptions of selected artworks from across the National. Each artwork included on this tour is signified in the gallery by a large AD symbol and a QR code, situated below the artwork label.

[Listen now Audio described tour](https://links.bloombergconnects.org/6Ggw/gp8rhrme)

### British sign language tour

Enjoy this British Sign Language (BSL) tour of Scottish artworks from the National. You can follow the tour in the gallery using your own smartphone or watch at home.

[Watch now British sign language tour](https://links.bloombergconnects.org/6Ggw/g9molyzw)

### Highlights guide - National

£7.00

From Da Vinci to Van Gogh, this is your guide to the most treasured and fascinating art on display at the National. 

Discover highlights of Scotland’s national art collection in this colour illustrated pocket guide to the National Galleries of Scotland: National. 

Compact yet rich in stories, this handy 15 x 15 cm guide explores the people, influences and histories behind some of the world’s most admired paintings, making it a perfect visitor companion or souvenir.

[Buy now](https://shop.nationalgalleries.org/all-products/highlights-guide-national/)

## Group visits

We welcome group visits to the galleries. Be inspired by the international art collection and special exhibitions, take part in activities and explore the resources available.

[Group visits](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/visit/group-visits) [School visits](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/visit/school-visits)

### Cafés and shops

### The Scottish Cafe & Restaurant

**Open daily, 10am-5pm (last orders 4pm).**

+44 (0)131 225 1550

Locatedat the main entrance to the National in East Princes Street Gardens, our restaurant offers incredible views east across the Gardens. The Scottish Cafe & Restaurant is run by Victor and Carina Contini who are committed to sustainable practices and buy direct from a trusted network of over 70 Scottish artisan suppliers.

Enjoy a lunch of Scottish classics like cullen skink and fish and chips or indulge yourself with all-day brunch or an afternoon tea. Avoid disappointment and book your table in advance. 

[Book here](https://www.contini.com/scottish-cafe-and-restaurant/book-table)

### Gallery Shop

**Open daily, 10am-5pm.**

+44 (0)131 624 6494

The shop at the National stocks Scottish gifts, books, limited edition prints, stationery, fashion, craft, design and exclusive products featuring well-loved images from Scottish artworks.

The shop is accessed via the main entrance in East Princes St. Gardens.

[Shop online](https://shop.nationalgalleries.org)

### Cafe Espresso

**Open daily, 10am-4pm**

+44 (0)131 225 1550

Situated just inside the mound entrance to the National, Espresso is the perfect rest stop for art lovers in need of refuelling. Easy counter service offers access to fantstic coffee as well as a selection of freshly baked scones and delicious cakes. No need to book in advance.

## Awards

### Trip Advisor Travellers' Choice 2025

[Review us Trip Advisor Travellers' Choice 2025](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attraction_Review-g186525-d219695-Reviews-National_Galleries_Scotland_National-Edinburgh_Scotland.html)

### Green Tourism Gold Award

[More about the Green Tourism Award Green Tourism Gold Award](https://www.green-tourism.com/pages/home#about)

[Sustainability at National Galleries of Scotland Green Tourism Gold Award](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/about-us/sustainability)

## While you're here

### Research Facilities

The National Galleries of Scotland offer a variety of opportunities for members of the public to access our resources and view artworks that are not on display in our gallery spaces. 

[More info Research Facilities](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/visit/research-facilities)

### Royal Scottish Academy

The Royal Scottish Academy plays host to a variety of exhibitions programmed by the National Galleries of Scotland, the Royal Scottish Academy of Art and Architecture, and others. 

[More info Royal Scottish Academy](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/visit/royal-scottish-academy-building)

### Portrait

The Portrait is just five minutes walk from the National. Come face to face with the people who shaped Scotland’s past, present and future. The perfect compliment to your visit.

[More info Portrait](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/visit/scottish-national-portrait-gallery)

## Venue hire

Situated in the very heart of Edinburgh, the National is one of the most prestigious venues for events.

[More info](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/venue-hire/national)

## About us

The National Galleries of Scotland cares for, develops, researches and displays the national collection of Scottish and international art and, with a lively and innovative programme of activities, exhibitions, education and publications, aims to engage, inform and inspire the broadest possible public.

[Find out more](https://www.nationalgalleries.org/about-us)

[**Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery**\\ \\ We're delighted that Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery has reopened its doors. Open spaces include The Pre-Raphaelites Galleries, Staffordshire Hoard Gallery, Birmingham History Galleries, Round Room, Industrial Gallery, Bridge Gallery, Wild City (a new family gallery), Tearoom, and Museum Shop, as well as a series of exhibitions.\\ \\ More Info](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/birmingham-museum-and-art-gallery/visit)

### Our exhibitions and special events

1. Exhibition

 Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery

 ### Neverland , at Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery.

 23 Oct 2026 - 3 Jan 2027. Open Tue - Sun and daily in holidays. (Closed on Christmas day.)

 A festive experience inspired by the beloved children’s classic, Peter Pan.

 [Details](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/exhibitions/neverland) [Book now](https://shop.birminghammuseums.org.uk/apps/book-tickets/#/event/917)

2. [Exhibition\\ \\ Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery\\ \\ **EVERY THING MUST GO by Joe Lycett , at Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery.**\\ \\ 29 July 2026 - 21 Feb 2027. Tue – Sun, 10am – 5pm. (Open daily in holidays). Closed 24-26 Dec and 1 Jan.\\ \\ First major solo exhibition of art by comedian Joe Lycett.\\ \\ Details](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/exhibitions/every-thing-must-go)
3. Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery

 ### Piece of Work - Poetry Night , at Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery.

 Selected Thursdays

 Birmingham's premiere poetry night.

 [Details](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/events/piece-of-work---poetry-at-bmag) [Book now](https://shop.birminghammuseums.org.uk/apps/book-tickets/#/event/845/slot/122037)

4. Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery

 ### Live printing demonstrations with Stirchley Printworks , at Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery.

 Selected days

 Live Printing Demonstrations Inspired by EVERY THING MUST GO.

 [Details](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/events/printing-demonstrations-with-stirchley-printworks-) [Drop-in](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/events/printing-demonstrations-with-stirchley-printworks-#dates-and-times)

5. Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery

 ### Pilates in EVERY THING MUST GO with Graft Pilates , at Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery.

 Sun 29 Nov

 Enjoy a Pilates session surrounded by work by Joe Lycett.

 [Details](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/events/pilates-at-the-joe-lycett-exhibtion-with-graft-pilates) [Book now](https://shop.birminghammuseums.org.uk/apps/book-tickets/#/event/876/slot/121945)

6. Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery

 ### William Morris Inspired Watercolour Workshop , at Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery.

 Sat 21 Nov

 [Details](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/events/william-morris-inspired-watercolour-workshop) [Drop-in](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/events/william-morris-inspired-watercolour-workshop#dates-and-times)

[**What's on**\\ \\ Find out about events and temporary exhibitions at Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery.\\ \\ Find out more](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/birmingham-museum-and-art-gallery/whats-on)

[**About**\\ \\ Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery is housed in a stunning Grade II\* listed landmark building that has watched over the city’s Chamberlain and Victoria Squares since 1885, welcoming millions of visitors over the years.\\ \\ More info](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/birmingham-museum-and-art-gallery/about)

[**Plan your visit**](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/birmingham-museum-and-art-gallery/visit)

[**Shop**](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/birmingham-museum-and-art-gallery/visit/shop)

[**What to see**\\ \\ Open spaces include the Birmingham History Galleries, Round Room, Industrial Gallery, Tearoom, and Museum Shop, plus a new family gallery, Wild City.\\ \\ More info](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/birmingham-museum-and-art-gallery/highlights)

### Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery opening times

**Term-time:**  
Open Tuesday - Sunday, 10am-5pm.

**Birmingham school holidays:**  
Open every day, 10am-5pm, on following dates: 24 October - 1 November.

Also open on bank holiday Mondays. 
Closed: 24-26 December and 1 January, with the exception of [Neverland](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/exhibitions/neverland) experience which is open on 24 and 26 December.

**Entry:**

- General admission is FREE. Donations are welcome, thank you for your support. No booking required.
- Some events and exhibitions may charge (see [What's On](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/birmingham-museum-and-art-gallery/whats-on?token=IfRWCkRhIIDj2uNPQ2-boqGense7wrSz) for details).
- Tearoom open 10am - 5pm.
- Last entry 4:45pm.

[Visit us](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/birmingham-museum-and-art-gallery/visit)

[**Christmas parties**](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/venue-hire/christmas-parties)

---

### Your Museums, Your Move

We have officially launched our major fundraising campaign to protect and deliver bold ambitions for the city’s cultural heritage.

The campaign, Your Museums, Your Move: It takes a city to save a story, aims to raise at least two million pounds over the next two years. Find out how you can [support us](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/support-us).

Watch our new video by poet Bradley Taylor, who has created a powerful piece for this campaign celebrating Birmingham Museums. 

[**Support us**\\ \\ From donations, membership to leaving a legacy in your will. Find out about the different ways that you can support us. \\ \\ Find out more](https://www.birminghammuseums.org.uk/support-us)

# you belong in ulster museum

A place to inspire wonder, encourage creativity and to understand the importance of our shared humanity.

Explore the Ulster Museum and make sense of the past, the present and the future through collections of art, natural science and history.

## Spotlight

[Paid exhibition\\ \\ Temporary Exhibition\\ \\ **Ashes to Fashion**\\ \\ Until Sunday 3rd January 2027\\ \\ Celebrate and commemorate fifty years of collecting fashion at the Ulster Museum and experience a collection reborn.\\ \\ Book Now](https://www.ulstermuseum.org/temporary-exhibition/ashes-fashion 'Ashes to Fashion ')

[Exhibition landing page\\ \\ **Troubles and Beyond**\\ \\ Ongoing\\ \\ This digital exhibition delves into the profound history of Northern Ireland from 1969 to the present, a period largely shaped by the conflict known as ‘the Troubles.’\\ \\ Digital Exhibition](https://www.ulstermuseum.org/digital-exhibitions/troubles-and-beyond-digital-exhibition 'Troubles and Beyond')

## More to explore

[Plan your visit](https://www.ulstermuseum.org/visit)

[Read stories](https://www.ulstermuseum.org/stories)

[Find out what's on](https://www.ulstermuseum.org/whats-on)

## News

[News\\ \\ **Oral history toolkit launches to help young people record Troubles experiences**\\ \\ 07.10.26\\ \\ Our Stories: Spoken, Recorded, Remembered was developed by oral historian Professor Chris Reynolds along with young people aged 14-25, for those aged 11 and above.\\ \\ Read news](https://www.ulstermuseum.org/news/oral-history-toolkit-launches 'Oral history toolkit launches to help young people record Troubles experiences')

[News\\ \\ **Belfast Bands perform at Ulster Museum for the first time**\\ \\ 22.06.2026\\ \\ A partnership with the Belfast Bands Forum is highlighting National Museums NI’s commitment to inclusivity.\\ \\ Read news](https://www.nationalmuseumsni.org/news/belfast-bands-forum 'Belfast Bands perform at Ulster Museum for the first time')

[News\\ \\ **'Flying Figures' fly again as Ulster Museum installs iconic sculptures on its façade**\\ \\ 24.03.2026\\ \\ Elisabeth Frink’s much-loved Flying Figures - also known as the Airborne Men - have been installed on the outside of the museum building, marking their first appearance since being gifted to the museum by Ulster Bank in 2023.\\ \\ Read news](https://www.ulstermuseum.org/news/flying-figures ''Flying Figures' fly again as Ulster Museum installs iconic sculptures on its façade')

The Ulster Museum explores the past, the present and the future through collections of art, natural science and history. It champions diverse voices and new perspectives to promote positive change in society.
